scope: HERO-ONLY refresh of Suja Contera luxury interior design landing page

hero_refresh_blueprint.problem_solved: Eliminated exterior estate image dominated by a huge central tree (photo-1600585154340-be6161a56a0c). Replaced with a warm, layered, double-height luxury interior living room featuring solid walnut paneling, honed marble, and ambient architectural lighting to immediately signal high-end interior craft.

hero_image_selection.alt_text: Bespoke luxury villa interior living room with custom walnut wall panelling and warm accent lighting
hero_image_selection.description: Double-height interior space showing interior architectural craft, walnut wood texture, Italian marble details, and warm indoor lighting. 0% exterior trees.

visual_decisions.overlay_strategy: Directional gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-r from-[#2C211A]/85 via-[#2C211A]/55 to-[#2C211A]/20) plus subtle vertical gradient (from-[#2C211A]/70 via-transparent to-[#2C211A]/80). Maintains minimum 4.5:1 text contrast on left content block while allowing the interior living room details on the right to shine without heavy flat darkening.

instructions_to_main_agent: Update HERO_IMG constant in /app/frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.jsx line 29 to 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1618221195710-dd6b41faaea6?auto=format&fit=crop&w=2400&q=80'.

Adjust the Hero section image overlay in LandingPage.jsx from a simple blanket dark gradient to a refined directional gradient (e.g. `bg-gradient-to-r from-brand-primary/90 via-brand-primary/60 to-brand-primary/20`) to highlight the interior living room details on the right.

Preserve all hero interactive callbacks: onBook scroll handler attached to 'Book Free Consultation' button, anchor link to #projects for 'View Portfolio', and data-testid attributes for test stability.
Maintain existing 3 service and property type categories: Apartment Interiors, Villa Interiors, and Independent Homes.
Do not add extra features outside the Hero refresh scope.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never use transparent backgrounds without blur or scrim on fixed headers.
Ensure all interactive elements retain data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='hero-headline', data-testid='hero-book-btn', data-testid='hero-portfolio-btn').
Keep typography scale ceilings strictly adhering to WCAG AA / APCA contrast standards.
